mapper.select: SELECT o.task_id FROM command_outbox o JOIN export_tasks t ON t.task_id=o.task_id WHERE t.status='PENDING' AND o.status IN ('READY','LEASED') AND o.dispatch_deadline>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND o.next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (o.status='READY' OR o.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY o.next_attempt_at,o.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM command_outbox WHERE task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE command_outbox SET status='SENT',sent_at=#{now},lease_owner=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_code=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='LEASED' AND lease_token=#{token}

UPDATE command_outbox SET status='READY',next_attempt_at=#{nextAt},last_error_code=#{safeCode},lease_owner=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='LEASED' AND lease_token=#{token}
UPDATE dispatch_attempts SET finished_at=#{now},outcome=#{outcome},safe_error=#{safeCode} WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND attempt_no=#{attempt} AND lease_token=#{token} AND finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT task_id FROM command_outbox WHERE status IN ('READY','LEASED') AND dispatch_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY dispatch_deadline,event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE command_outbox SET status='CLOSED',closed_at=#{now},close_reason=#{reason},lease_owner=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('READY','LEASED')
